readerCopy.body: A familiar source of comfort can help, especially if you do not confuse relief with a solution. The Moon sextile the South Node can make an old routine, family connection, home ritual, or emotional skill easier to reach. Returning to something known may give you enough steadiness to deal with what is happening instead of reacting from the middle of it. Take the support. Just notice if the comforting choice also helps you avoid the conversation, change, or decision that still needs to happen.
